about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: You were matched because you share interests in live music and gigs, and you like similar weekends like the cinema. Your mentor is also the laid-back kind you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet every two weeks.

checklist.reply:
On your checklist, you still need to join a society and find a dentist. 

Since you're studying English Literature and enjoy reading, you might like the [[Book]] society. Would you like help with either of those checklist items?

who is my mentor.reply: You can find your mentor's name and contact details on the Your Mentor page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply:
Since you study BA English Literature, [[English]] fits your course well, and [[Book]] matches your interest in reading. 

Would you like to know how to join either of them?

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: Our mentoring coordinator is finding your mentor by hand. You can check the Your Mentor page to see them and get in touch once they're assigned.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet, but you can easily find one on the Find a mentor page whenever you are ready.
